objective: Estimate the empirical probability that a randomly selected Olympic medalist record (1980-2016) from a country that also produced at least one NBA player on a team founded after 1970 has a height strictly greater than the median height of those qualifying NBA players. Also report shared-country count, NBA median height (cm) and Olympic medalist record count, and persist to output.json.

unit_of_analysis.olympic_side: athlete-event record (one row per athlete per event); a multi-medal or multi-event athlete contributes multiple rows (matches task wording 'medalist record')
unit_of_analysis.nba_side: player record from common_player_info filtered to teams founded after 1970
unit_of_analysis.probability: numerator = # Olympic medalist rows from shared countries with Height_cm > NBA_median_cm; denominator = # Olympic medalist rows from shared countries

athlete_events.csv.row_level_fact: one row per athlete per event; Team text column is messy (historical/combined team names), NOC is the reliable country key

NBA Database/common_player_info.csv.team_id_notes: team_id 0 and 1610610023-1610610037 are defunct/all-star/unmatched ids absent from team.csv

NBA Database/team.csv.join_caveat: match on team.csv.id == common_player_info.team_id; do NOT join on abbreviation (differs: GOS vs GSW, VAN/BKN franchise shifts)

steps.name: Load and normalize Olympic medalist records
actions: Read athlete_events.csv with explicit dtypes (ID int32, Year int16, Height/Weight float32; categorical NOC/Sport/Event/Medal) to control memory.
Filter Year between 1980 and 2016 inclusive (both Summer and Winter).
Filter Medal.notna() (Gold/Silver/Bronze).
Expected: 21926 records.

steps.name: Attach and standardize Olympic country names
actions: Left-join noc_regions on NOC to get 'region' as canonical country name.
Drop/report rows with null region (ROT/TUV/UNK + SGP unmapped): expected 8 rows lost; document as a decision.
Apply alias normalization to canonical region labels so they are comparable with NBA country strings (see country_alias_map).

steps.name: Impute missing Olympic heights (sport-specific medians)
actions: Compute sport-level median Height over the 1980-2016 medalist subset.
Fill null Height with the row's sport median; fallback to full medalist-subset median if a sport has no non-null heights.
Report imputed count (expected 383 of 21926) and the sports with most imputations; verify no heights remain null.
Guardrail: sanity-check imputed values against plausible sport ranges (e.g. no imputed value outside 130-230 cm).
steps.outputs: olympic_medals with height_cm_olympic (single imputation pass, no iterative refinement)

steps.name: Select qualifying NBA players
actions: Read team.csv; select id where year_founded > 1970 (13 teams, strict '>' since Cleveland Cavaliers and LA Clippers are exactly 1970 and must be excluded).
Filter common_player_info to team_id in that id set (expected 911 players).
Report/exclude players whose team_id is not in team.csv (defunct/unknown ids) and players with null country (expected 1) from the country set.
Sensitivity note: team_id in this dataset is the player's listed (most recent) team only, not full career history.

steps.name: Convert and impute NBA heights
actions: Parse feet-inches: split height on '-', height_cm = (feet*12 + inches)*2.54.

Handle nulls: fill with position-group median (map Guard-Forward->Guard, Forward-Guard->Guard, Forward-Center->Forward, Center-Forward->Forward; Center->Center). Expected 0 nulls inside the 911-player filter, so this is a no-op fallback.
Verify plausible range 150-250 cm and that the modal values look correct (e.g. 6-6 -> 198.12).

steps.name: Standardize NBA country names
actions: Strip whitespace, apply country_alias_map to map NBA labels onto the same canonical vocabulary used for Olympic regions.

Key concern: noc_regions uses abbreviated/odd region labels ('UK', 'Trinidad', 'Virgin Islands, US', 'Cape Verde', 'Republic of Congo', 'Antigua', 'Saint Vincent', 'Saint Kitts', 'Boliva'), so normalization must reconcile both directions.

Report the NBA country labels that fail to match any Olympic country - expected unmatched: Belize, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Congo, Saint Lucia, Scotland (these have no 1980-2016 medalist records, or map via alias only if a match exists).

steps.name: Compute shared countries and NBA median height
actions: shared_countries = set(nba_qual.country_std) INTERSECT set(olympic_medals.country_std) (countries with >=1 qualifying NBA player and >=1 Olympic medalist record).

nba_median_height = median of height_cm over nba_qual players whose country_std is in shared_countries (equivalently over all qualified players if no excluded country is in shared set - check and report which convention is used; preferred: median over the shared-country qualified NBA players per task wording 'the median height of those NBA players').
Expected reference values: shared countries ~42, nba_median ~200.66 cm (6-7 = 200.66).

steps.name: Compute probability
actions: denominator = # olympic_medals rows with country_std in shared_countries (expected 16243 of 21926).
numerator = # of those rows with height_cm_olympic > nba_median_height (strict inequality).
probability = numerator / denominator, rounded to 4 dp.
Also compute a tie diagnostic: count rows with height exactly equal to the median (ties excluded from numerator) and report sensitivity if ties were included.

steps.name: Write output.json and validate
actions: Write output.json with the exact required schema: probability (float, 4dp), shared_countries_count (int), nba_median_height (float, 2dp), olympic_athletes_count (int).
Validate: probability within [0,1]; shared_countries_count <= min(nba country count, olympic country count); olympic_athletes_count <= 21926; JSON parses; only the 4 required keys present.
Persist intermediates (per-country stats, imputation log) to analysis_details.json for auditability.

country_alias_map.direction: canonical label = noc_regions.region style; NBA labels mapped onto it

nba_side_fixes.Scotland: UNMATCHED (no separate Olympic region; UK is used by GBR records) - keep as its own label and report

country_alias_map.matching_rule: compare case-insensitively, strip punctuation/whitespace, then apply alias map; unmatched labels are logged, never silently fused

verification_checkpoints.tolerance_policy: any deviation from the expected reference values must be explained by a documented decision (filter boundary, alias, tie handling, imputation method) rather than accepted silently

risks_and_edge_cases: Team column in athlete_events is historically messy (e.g. 'Yugoslavia', 'Soviet Union', 'Mixed team'); must use NOC -> region, never the Team text, for country matching.

Historical NOCs (URS, TCH, YUG, GDR, FRG) disintegrate into successor countries in the NBA data (Serbia, Croatia, Slovenia, Russia, Germany, etc.) - no attempt is made to retro-map successors; matching is on exactly the post-1980 NOC->region label. This is the single largest driver of the shared-country list.
Strict year_founded > 1970 excludes Cleveland Cavaliers and LA Clippers (founded exactly 1970) - material, since both are roster-heavy franchises.
team_id represents only the player's listed team; players whose only post-1970 tenure is elsewhere are still counted via their listed team only. Documented as a data limitation.
Strict '>' comparison against the median: Olympic records exactly equal to the NBA median are counted in the denominator but not the numerator (probability is small, so tie sensitivity is reported).
383 imputed Olympic heights (1.7% of records) - imputation via sport median can shift the numerator by a few dozen records at most; quantify by running a drop-nulls sensitivity variant.
Single-pass imputation: sport medians computed on the pre-imputation subset, not re-estimated after filling.
SGP is missing from noc_regions (8 medalist rows) - excluded; alternative is mapping SGP manually to Singapore; report the delta.
Mixed/duplicated athletes: same ID appearing in multiple events inflates counts by design (record-level unit).
NBA position strings are compound (Guard-Forward etc.); median imputation must use the grouped position, not the raw string.

keys.probability: float, empirical probability rounded to 4 decimals
keys.shared_countries_count: int, # countries common to Olympic medalists (1980-2016) and qualifying NBA players
keys.nba_median_height: float, median height of qualifying NBA players in cm, 2 decimals
keys.olympic_athletes_count: int, # Olympic medalist records from shared countries

acceptance_criteria: output.json exists, parses as JSON, and contains exactly the four required keys with the specified types/rounding.
All artefacts reproducible from a single script run against the four input files with no manual edits.
Every documented decision in this plan is reflected in code comments and in analysis_details.json.
Reported numbers reconcile with the verification_checkpoints or the deviation is explained.
